The Department of Science at Trine University is a part of the Rinker-Ross School of Health Sciences, and offers B.S degrees in chemistry, biochemistry, biology, and forensic science. The department is housed in the Best Hall of Science and has recently moved into a new $6.6 million, 26,000 square-foot addition.
